Speed limits and road geometry come from OpenStreetMap data, © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database Licence (ODbL).
Maps are rendered by the Google Maps SDK. Place suggestions and route estimates in convoys use the Places and Routes APIs.
Weather at the start of each trip comes from the Open-Meteo API (CC BY 4.0, non-commercial).
Place names for saved places use the OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocoder, sparingly and cached.
Regional OpenStreetMap extracts used to build the speed-limit packs.
Drivalry is free, open source (MIT) and runs on free tiers. Raw GPS never leaves your phone.
